{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Private-sector unions and those engaged in living wage and raising-the-minimum-wage struggles often act as though strengthening the power of labor in the private market by itself can raise working-class and poor people’s living standards.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Improving the power of workers in the labor market is a key part of the social justice project.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Without progressive taxation, expansion and restoration of high quality universal public provision and social insurance, and massive military spending cuts, the nation will not be able to provide equity for the poor and the working poor.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Providing equity for the poor and the working poor requires reconstructing a strong public sector and bringing the social wage up to at least the level underpinning the more egalitarian societies of Western Europe.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Reconstructing a strong public sector and bringing the social wage up to at least the level underpinning the more egalitarian societies of Western Europe requires politics and allies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Allies are especially needed among those who can be won to resisting the privatization of inherently governmental functions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The public can be persuaded to oppose privatization and increase support for the public sector.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Making connections to oppose privatization and increase support for the public sector is one way to begin building longer-term strategic alliances around citizen challenges to corporate control of government.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
